items.text:
अतः परं प्रवक्ष्यामि प्राणिहत्यासु निष्कृतिम् ।
पराशरेन पूर्वोक्ता मन्वर्थेऽपि च विस्तृतां ॥ १ ॥
items.tr:
ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi prāṇihatyāsu niṣkṛtim |
parāśarena pūrvoktā manvarthe'pi ca vistṛtāṃ || 1 ||
items.en: Next I will explain the penances for killing living beings, which Parāśara stated before and which are also explained in detail in Manu's teaching.

items.text:
क्रौञ्चसारसहंसांश्च चक्रवाकं च कुक्कुटम् ।
जालपादं च शरभं अहोरात्रेण शुध्यति ॥ २ ॥
items.tr:
krauñcasārasahaṃsāṃśca cakravākaṃ ca kukkuṭam |
jālapādaṃ ca śarabhaṃ ahorātreṇa śudhyati || 2 ||
items.en: One who kills a krauñca crane, a sārasa crane, a swan, a cakravāka goose, a rooster, a web-footed bird or a śarabha becomes pure by a day and a night of fasting.
items.note: śarabha: a fabulous eight-legged beast, or some large animal; its identity is unclear.

items.text:
बलाकाटिट्टिभौ वापि शुकपारावतावपि ।
अहिनक्रविघाती च शुध्यते नक्तभोजनात् ॥ ३ ॥
items.tr:
balākāṭiṭṭibhau vāpi śukapārāvatāvapi |
ahinakravighātī ca śudhyate naktabhojanāt || 3 ||
items.en: One who kills an egret, a lapwing, a parrot or a pigeon, or who kills a snake or a crocodile, becomes pure by eating only at night.
items.note: nakta: a penance of eating only one meal, at night.

items.text:
वृककाककपोतानां शारितित्तिरिघातकः ।
अन्तर्जल उभे संध्ये प्राणायामेन शुध्यति ॥ ४ ॥
items.tr:
vṛkakākakapotānāṃ śāritittirighātakaḥ |
antarjala ubhe saṃdhye prāṇāyāmena śudhyati || 4 ||
items.en: One who kills a wolf, a crow, a dove, a myna or a partridge becomes pure by doing breath control while standing in water at morning and evening twilight.
items.note: prāṇāyāma: ritual breath control.

items.text:
गृध्रश्येनशशादानां उलूकस्य च घातकः ।
अपक्वाशी दिनं तिष्ठेत्त्रिकालं मारुताशनः ॥ ५ ॥
items.tr:
gṛdhraśyenaśaśādānāṃ ulūkasya ca ghātakaḥ |
apakvāśī dinaṃ tiṣṭhettrikālaṃ mārutāśanaḥ || 5 ||
items.en: One who kills a vulture, a hawk, a falcon or an owl should spend a day eating only uncooked food, and at the three times of day he should live on air alone.
items.note: The verse may mean either a day on uncooked food plus fasting at the three prayer times, or a choice between the two; the wording is unclear.

items.text:
वल्गुणीटिट्टिभानां च कोकिलाखञ्जरीटके ।
लाविकारक्तपक्षेषु शुध्यते नक्तभोजनात् ॥ ६ ॥
items.tr:
valguṇīṭiṭṭibhānāṃ ca kokilākhañjarīṭake |
lāvikāraktapakṣeṣu śudhyate naktabhojanāt || 6 ||
items.en: For killing a bat, a lapwing, a cuckoo, a wagtail, a quail or a red-winged bird, one becomes pure by eating only at night.

items.text:
कारण्डवचकोराणां पिङ्गलाकुररस्य च ।
भारद्वाजादिकं हत्वा शिवं पूज्य विशुध्यति ॥ ७ ॥
items.tr:
kāraṇḍavacakorāṇāṃ piṅgalākurarasya ca |
bhāradvājādikaṃ hatvā śivaṃ pūjya viśudhyati || 7 ||
items.en: After killing a kāraṇḍava duck, a cakora partridge, a piṅgalā bird, an osprey, a skylark or similar birds, one becomes pure by worshipping Śiva.

items.text:
भेरुण्डचाषभासांश्च पारावतकपिञ्जलौ ।
पक्षिणां चैव सर्वेषां अहोरात्रं अभोजनम् ॥ ८ ॥
items.tr:
bheruṇḍacāṣabhāsāṃśca pārāvatakapiñjalau |
pakṣiṇāṃ caiva sarveṣāṃ ahorātraṃ abhojanam || 8 ||
items.en: For the bheruṇḍa, the blue jay, the bhāsa bird, the pigeon, the kapiñjala partridge, and indeed for all birds, the penance is a day and a night without food.

items.text:
हत्वा मूषकमार्जार सर्पाजगरडुण्डुभान् ।
कृसरं भोजयेद्विप्रान्लोहदण्डश्च दक्षिणा ॥ ९ ॥
items.tr:
hatvā mūṣakamārjāra sarpājagaraḍuṇḍubhān |
kṛsaraṃ bhojayedviprānlohadaṇḍaśca dakṣiṇā || 9 ||
items.en: After killing a mouse, a cat, a snake, a python or a water snake, one should feed Brahmins with kṛsara, and an iron rod is the dakṣiṇā.
items.note: kṛsara: a dish of rice, sesame and milk. dakṣiṇā: the fee or gift given to Brahmins for a rite.

items.text:
शिशुमारं तथा गोधां हत्वा कूर्मं च शल्यकम् ।
वृन्ताकफलभक्षी चाप्यहोरात्रेण शुध्यति ॥ १० ॥
items.tr:
śiśumāraṃ tathā godhāṃ hatvā kūrmaṃ ca śalyakam |
vṛntākaphalabhakṣī cāpyahorātreṇa śudhyati || 10 ||
items.en: One who kills a dolphin, a monitor lizard, a tortoise or a porcupine becomes pure in a day and a night, eating only eggplant.

items.text:
वृकजम्बूकऋक्षाणां तरक्षुश्वानघातकः ।
तिलप्रस्थं द्विजे दद्याद्वायुभक्षो दिनत्रयं ॥ ११ ॥
items.tr:
vṛkajambūkaṛkṣāṇāṃ tarakṣuśvānaghātakaḥ |
tilaprasthaṃ dvije dadyādvāyubhakṣo dinatrayaṃ || 11 ||
items.en: One who kills a wolf, a jackal, a bear, a hyena or a dog should give a prastha of sesame to a Brahmin and live on air for three days.
items.note: prastha: a measure of grain, roughly a little under a kilogram.

items.text:
गजस्य च तुरङ्गस्य महिषोष्ट्रनिपातने ।
प्रायश्चित्तं अहोरात्रं त्रिसंध्यं अवगाहनं ॥ १२ ॥
items.tr:
gajasya ca turaṅgasya mahiṣoṣṭranipātane |
prāyaścittaṃ ahorātraṃ trisaṃdhyaṃ avagāhanaṃ || 12 ||
items.en: For killing an elephant, a horse, a buffalo or a camel, the penance is a day and a night of fasting and bathing at the three times of day.

items.text:
कुरङ्गं वानरं सिंहं चित्रं व्याघ्रं तु घातयन् ।
शुध्यते स त्रिरात्रेण विप्राणां तर्पणेन च ॥ १३ ॥
items.tr:
kuraṅgaṃ vānaraṃ siṃhaṃ citraṃ vyāghraṃ tu ghātayan |
śudhyate sa trirātreṇa viprāṇāṃ tarpaṇena ca || 13 ||
items.en: One who kills a deer, a monkey, a lion, a leopard or a tiger becomes pure in three nights and by feeding Brahmins.

items.text:
मृगरोहिद्वराहाणां अवेर्बस्तस्य घातकः ।
अफालकृष्टं अश्नीयादहोरात्रं उपोष्य सः ॥ १४ ॥
items.tr:
mṛgarohidvarāhāṇāṃ averbastasya ghātakaḥ |
aphālakṛṣṭaṃ aśnīyādahorātraṃ upoṣya saḥ || 14 ||
items.en: One who kills a deer, a red deer, a boar, a sheep or a goat should fast for a day and a night and then eat food grown on unploughed land.

items.text:
एवं चतुष्पदानां च सर्वेषां वनचारिणाम् ।
अहोरात्रोषितस्तिष्ठेज्जपेद्वै जातवेदसं ॥ १५ ॥
items.tr:
evaṃ catuṣpadānāṃ ca sarveṣāṃ vanacāriṇām |
ahorātroṣitastiṣṭhejjapedvai jātavedasaṃ || 15 ||
items.en: In the same way, for all four-footed animals that live in the forest, one should fast for a day and a night and recite the Jātavedas hymn.
items.note: Jātavedas: a name of Agni, the fire god; the hymn is Ṛgveda 1.99.

items.text:
शिल्पिनं कारुकं शूद्रं स्त्रियं वा यस्तु घातयेत् ।
प्राजापत्यद्वयं कृत्वा वृषैकादशदक्षिणा ॥ १६ ॥
items.tr:
śilpinaṃ kārukaṃ śūdraṃ striyaṃ vā yastu ghātayet |
prājāpatyadvayaṃ kṛtvā vṛṣaikādaśadakṣiṇā || 16 ||
items.en: Whoever kills an artisan, a craftsman, a Śūdra or a woman should perform two Prājāpatya penances and give eleven bulls as dakṣiṇā.

items.text:
वैश्यं वा क्षत्रियं वापि निर्दोषं योऽभिघातयेत् ।
सोऽपि कृच्छ्रद्वयं कुर्याद्गोविंशद्दक्षिणां ददेत् ॥ १७ ॥
items.tr:
vaiśyaṃ vā kṣatriyaṃ vāpi nirdoṣaṃ yo'bhighātayet |
so'pi kṛcchradvayaṃ kuryādgoviṃśaddakṣiṇāṃ dadet || 17 ||
items.en: Whoever kills an innocent Vaiśya or Kṣatriya should perform two Kṛcchra penances and give twenty cows as dakṣiṇā.
items.note: Kṛcchra: a hard penance; when not further named it usually means the 12-day Prājāpatya.

items.text:
वैश्यं शूद्रं क्रियासक्तं विकर्मस्थं द्विजोत्तमम् ।
हत्वा चान्द्रायणं तस्य त्रिंशद्गोश्चैव दक्षिणां ॥ १८ ॥
items.tr:
vaiśyaṃ śūdraṃ kriyāsaktaṃ vikarmasthaṃ dvijottamam |
hatvā cāndrāyaṇaṃ tasya triṃśadgoścaiva dakṣiṇāṃ || 18 ||
items.en: For killing a Vaiśya or a Śūdra who is devoted to his rites, or a Brahmin who has taken up forbidden work, the penance is Cāndrāyaṇa and thirty cows as dakṣiṇā.
items.note: Cāndrāyaṇa: a month-long penance where daily food is cut by one mouthful as the moon wanes and raised by one as it waxes.

items.text:
चण्डालं हतवान्कश्चिद्ब्राह्मणे यदि कंचन ।
प्राजापत्यं चरेत्कृच्छ्रं गोद्वयं दक्षिणां ददत् ॥ १९ ॥
items.tr:
caṇḍālaṃ hatavānkaścidbrāhmaṇe yadi kaṃcana |
prājāpatyaṃ caretkṛcchraṃ godvayaṃ dakṣiṇāṃ dadat || 19 ||
items.en: If a Brahmin kills a Caṇḍāla, he should perform the Prājāpatya Kṛcchra and give two cows as dakṣiṇā.

items.text:
क्षत्रियेणापि वैश्येन शूद्रेणैवेतरेण वा ।
चण्डालस्य वधे प्राप्ते कृच्छ्रार्धेन विशुध्यति ॥ २० ॥
items.tr:
kṣatriyeṇāpi vaiśyena śūdreṇaivetareṇa vā |
caṇḍālasya vadhe prāpte kṛcchrārdhena viśudhyati || 20 ||
items.en: If a Kṣatriya, a Vaiśya, a Śūdra or anyone else kills a Caṇḍāla, he becomes pure by half a Kṛcchra.

items.text:
चोरौ श्वपाकचण्डालौ विप्रेणाभिहतौ यदि ।
अहोरात्रोषितः स्नात्वा पञ्चगव्येन शुध्यति ॥ २१ ॥
items.tr:
corau śvapākacaṇḍālau vipreṇābhihatau yadi |
ahorātroṣitaḥ snātvā pañcagavyena śudhyati || 21 ||
items.en: If a Brahmin kills thieves who are Śvapākas or Caṇḍālas, he should fast for a day and a night, bathe, and becomes pure by taking pañcagavya.
items.note: pañcagavya: the five cow products (milk, curd, ghee, urine, dung) mixed and taken for purification.

items.text:
श्वपाकं वापि चण्डालं विप्रः संभाषते यदि ।
दिव्जसंभाषणं कुर्यात्सावित्रीं तु सकृज्जपेत् ॥ २२ ॥
items.tr:
śvapākaṃ vāpi caṇḍālaṃ vipraḥ saṃbhāṣate yadi |
divjasaṃbhāṣaṇaṃ kuryātsāvitrīṃ tu sakṛjjapet || 22 ||
items.en: If a Brahmin talks with a Śvapāka or a Caṇḍāla, he should then talk with a twice-born man and recite the Sāvitrī once.
items.note: Sāvitrī: another name for the Gāyatrī verse.

items.text:
चण्डालैः सह सुप्तं तु त्रिरात्रं उपवासयेत् ।
चण्डालैकपथं गत्वा गायत्रीस्मरणाच्छुचिः ॥ २३ ॥
items.tr:
caṇḍālaiḥ saha suptaṃ tu trirātraṃ upavāsayet |
caṇḍālaikapathaṃ gatvā gāyatrīsmaraṇācchuciḥ || 23 ||
items.en: One who has slept alongside Caṇḍālas should fast for three nights. One who has walked on the same road as Caṇḍālas becomes pure by calling the Gāyatrī to mind.

items.text:
चण्डालदर्शने सद्य आदित्यं अवलोकयेत् ।
चण्डालस्पर्शने चैव सचैलं स्नानं आचरेत् ॥ २४ ॥
items.tr:
caṇḍāladarśane sadya ādityaṃ avalokayet |
caṇḍālasparśane caiva sacailaṃ snānaṃ ācaret || 24 ||
items.en: On seeing a Caṇḍāla one should at once look at the sun. On touching a Caṇḍāla one should bathe with one's clothes on.

items.text:
चण्डालखातवापीषु पीत्वा सलिलं अग्रजः ।
अज्ञानाच्चैकभक्तेन त्वहोरात्रेण शुध्यति ॥ २५ ॥
items.tr:
caṇḍālakhātavāpīṣu pītvā salilaṃ agrajaḥ |
ajñānāccaikabhaktena tvahorātreṇa śudhyati || 25 ||
items.en: If a Brahmin unknowingly drinks water from a well or pond dug by Caṇḍālas, he becomes pure by eating only one meal over a day and a night.

items.text:
चण्डालभाण्डसंस्पृष्टं पीत्वा कूपगतं जलम् ।
गोमूत्रयावकाहारस्त्रिरात्राच्छुद्धिं आप्नुयात् ॥ २६ ॥
items.tr:
caṇḍālabhāṇḍasaṃspṛṣṭaṃ pītvā kūpagataṃ jalam |
gomūtrayāvakāhārastrirātrācchuddhiṃ āpnuyāt || 26 ||
items.en: One who drinks well water that a Caṇḍāla's pot has touched becomes pure after three nights of living on barley cooked in cow urine.
items.note: gomūtra-yāvaka: barley cooked in cow urine, a penance diet.

items.text:
चण्डालघटसंस्थं तु यत्तोयं पिबति द्विजः ।
तत्क्षणात्क्षिपते यस्तु प्राजापत्यं समाचरेत् ॥ २७ ॥
items.tr:
caṇḍālaghaṭasaṃsthaṃ tu yattoyaṃ pibati dvijaḥ |
tatkṣaṇātkṣipate yastu prājāpatyaṃ samācaret || 27 ||
items.en: If a twice-born man drinks water kept in a Caṇḍāla's pot and vomits it up at once, he should perform the Prājāpatya.

items.text:
यदि न क्षिपते तोयं शरीरे यस्य जीर्यति ।
प्राजापत्यं न दातव्यं कृच्छ्रं सांतपनं चरेत् ॥ २८ ॥
items.tr:
yadi na kṣipate toyaṃ śarīre yasya jīryati |
prājāpatyaṃ na dātavyaṃ kṛcchraṃ sāṃtapanaṃ caret || 28 ||
items.en: If he does not throw up the water and it is digested in his body, Prājāpatya is not enough; he should perform the Sāntapana Kṛcchra.
items.note: Sāntapana: a penance of one day taking only pañcagavya and kuśa water, followed by one day of full fast (longer forms exist).

items.text:
चरेत्सांतपनं विप्रः प्राजापत्यं अनन्तरः ।
तदर्धं तु चरेद्वैश्यः पादं शूद्रस्तदाचरेत् ॥ २९ ॥
items.tr:
caretsāṃtapanaṃ vipraḥ prājāpatyaṃ anantaraḥ |
tadardhaṃ tu caredvaiśyaḥ pādaṃ śūdrastadācaret || 29 ||
items.en: A Brahmin should perform the Sāntapana, the next varṇa (Kṣatriya) the Prājāpatya, a Vaiśya half of that, and a Śūdra a quarter.

items.text:
भाण्डस्थं अन्त्यजानां तु जलं दधि पयः पिबेत् ।
ब्राह्मणः क्षत्रियो वैश्यः शूद्रश्चैव प्रमादतः ॥ ३० ॥
items.tr:
bhāṇḍasthaṃ antyajānāṃ tu jalaṃ dadhi payaḥ pibet |
brāhmaṇaḥ kṣatriyo vaiśyaḥ śūdraścaiva pramādataḥ || 30 ||
items.en: If a Brahmin, a Kṣatriya, a Vaiśya or a Śūdra carelessly drinks water, curd or milk kept in a vessel belonging to the lowest castes,
items.note: antyaja: 'last-born', the lowest groups outside the four varṇas.

items.text:
ब्रह्मकूर्चोपवासेन द्विजातीनां तु निष्कृतिः ।
शूद्रस्य चोपवासेन तथा दानेन शक्तितः ॥ ३१ ॥
items.tr:
brahmakūrcopavāsena dvijātīnāṃ tu niṣkṛtiḥ |
śūdrasya copavāsena tathā dānena śaktitaḥ || 31 ||
items.en: … the penance for twice-born men is the Brahmakūrca fast, and for a Śūdra it is a fast and giving gifts as far as he is able.
items.note: Brahmakūrca: a one-day fast followed by drinking pañcagavya consecrated with mantras.

items.text:
भुङ्क्तेऽज्ञानाद्द्विजश्रेष्ठश्चण्डालान्नं कथंचन ।
गोमूत्रयावकाहारो दशरात्रेण शुध्यति ॥ ३२ ॥
items.tr:
bhuṅkte'jñānāddvijaśreṣṭhaścaṇḍālānnaṃ kathaṃcana |
gomūtrayāvakāhāro daśarātreṇa śudhyati || 32 ||
items.en: If a high twice-born man unknowingly eats a Caṇḍāla's food in any way, he becomes pure in ten nights by living on barley cooked in cow urine.

items.text:
एकैकं ग्रासं अश्नीयाद्गोमूत्रयावकस्य च ।
दशाहं नियमस्थस्य व्रतं तत्तु विनिर्दिशेत् ॥ ३३ ॥
items.tr:
ekaikaṃ grāsaṃ aśnīyādgomūtrayāvakasya ca |
daśāhaṃ niyamasthasya vrataṃ tattu vinirdiśet || 33 ||
items.en: He should eat that barley cooked in cow urine one mouthful at a time. This is to be declared his vow, kept with discipline for ten days.

items.text:
अविज्ञातस्तु चण्डालो यत्र वेश्मनि तिष्ठति ।
विज्ञाते तु७पसन्नस्य द्विजाः कुर्वन्त्यनुग्रहं ॥ ३४ ॥
items.tr:
avijñātastu caṇḍālo yatra veśmani tiṣṭhati |
vijñāte tu7pasannasya dvijāḥ kurvantyanugrahaṃ || 34 ||
items.en: If a Caṇḍāla has been living in someone's house without being recognised, then once it is found out and the householder comes to them, the Brahmins should help him.

items.text:
मुनिवक्त्रोद्गतान्धर्मान्गायन्तो वेदपारगाः ।
पतन्तं उद्धरेयुस्तं धर्मज्ञाः पापसंकरात् ॥ ३५ ॥
items.tr:
munivaktrodgatāndharmāngāyanto vedapāragāḥ |
patantaṃ uddhareyustaṃ dharmajñāḥ pāpasaṃkarāt || 35 ||
items.en: The Vedic scholars who know dharma, reciting the laws that came from the mouths of the sages, should lift up the man who is falling because of this sinful mixing.

items.text:
दध्ना च सर्पिषा चैव क्षीरगोमूत्रयावकम् ।
भुञ्जीत सह सर्वैश्च त्रिसंध्यं अवगाहनं ॥ ३६ ॥
items.tr:
dadhnā ca sarpiṣā caiva kṣīragomūtrayāvakam |
bhuñjīta saha sarvaiśca trisaṃdhyaṃ avagāhanaṃ || 36 ||
items.en: He should eat barley cooked in cow urine with curd, ghee and milk, together with all his household, and bathe at the three times of day.

items.text:
त्र्यहं भुञ्जीत दध्ना च त्र्यहं भुञ्जीत सर्पिषा ।
त्र्यहं क्षीरेण भुञ्जीत एकैकेन दिनत्रयम् ॥ ३७ ॥
items.tr:
tryahaṃ bhuñjīta dadhnā ca tryahaṃ bhuñjīta sarpiṣā |
tryahaṃ kṣīreṇa bhuñjīta ekaikena dinatrayam || 37 ||
items.en: For three days he should eat it with curd, for three days with ghee, and for three days with milk, each for three days.

items.text:
भावदुष्टं न भुञ्जीत नोच्छिष्टं कृमिदूषितम् ।
दधिक्षीरस्य त्रिपलं पलं एकं घृतस्य तु ॥ ३८ ॥
items.tr:
bhāvaduṣṭaṃ na bhuñjīta nocchiṣṭaṃ kṛmidūṣitam |
dadhikṣīrasya tripalaṃ palaṃ ekaṃ ghṛtasya tu || 38 ||
items.en: He should not eat food that is spoiled, leftover or infested with worms. The amount of curd and milk is three palas, and of ghee one pala.
items.note: pala: a weight of roughly 40–50 grams.

items.text:
भस्मना तु भवेच्छुद्धिरुभयोस्ताम्रकांस्ययोः ।
जलशौचेन वस्त्राणां परित्यागेन मृण्मयम् ॥ ३९ ॥
items.tr:
bhasmanā tu bhavecchuddhirubhayostāmrakāṃsyayoḥ |
jalaśaucena vastrāṇāṃ parityāgena mṛṇmayam || 39 ||
items.en: Copper and bronze things are purified with ash, clothes by washing with water, and clay pots by throwing them away.

items.text:
कुसुम्भगुडकार्पास लवणं तैलसर्पिषी ।
द्वारे कृत्वा तु धान्यानि दद्याद्वेश्मनि पावकम् ॥ ४० ॥
items.tr:
kusumbhaguḍakārpāsa lavaṇaṃ tailasarpiṣī |
dvāre kṛtvā tu dhānyāni dadyādveśmani pāvakam || 40 ||
items.en: Safflower, jaggery, cotton, salt, oil, ghee and grains should be put outside the door, and then the house should be set on fire.

items.text:
एवं शुद्धस्ततः पश्चात्कुर्याद्ब्राह्मणतर्पणम् ।
त्रिंशतं गोवृषं चैकं दद्याद्विप्रेषु दक्षिणां ॥ ४१ ॥
items.tr:
evaṃ śuddhastataḥ paścātkuryādbrāhmaṇatarpaṇam |
triṃśataṃ govṛṣaṃ caikaṃ dadyādvipreṣu dakṣiṇāṃ || 41 ||
items.en: After he has been purified in this way, he should feed Brahmins and give thirty cows and one bull to the Brahmins as dakṣiṇā.

items.text:
पुनर्लेपनखातेन होमजप्येन शुध्यति ।
आधारेण च विप्राणां भूमिदोषो न विद्यते ॥ ४२ ॥
items.tr:
punarlepanakhātena homajapyena śudhyati |
ādhāreṇa ca viprāṇāṃ bhūmidoṣo na vidyate || 42 ||
items.en: The ground becomes pure by plastering it again and digging it, and by homa and japa. With the Brahmins' support, no fault remains in the ground.
items.note: homa: an offering into fire. japa: repeated recitation of a mantra.

items.text:
चण्डालैः सह संपर्कं मासं मासार्धं एव वा ।
गोमूत्रयावकाहारो मासार्धेन विशुध्यति ॥ ४३ ॥
items.tr:
caṇḍālaiḥ saha saṃparkaṃ māsaṃ māsārdhaṃ eva vā |
gomūtrayāvakāhāro māsārdhena viśudhyati || 43 ||
items.en: For contact with Caṇḍālas lasting a month or half a month, one becomes pure in half a month by living on barley cooked in cow urine.

items.text:
रजकी चर्मकारी च लुब्धकी वेणुजीविनी ।
चातुर्वर्ण्यस्य च गृहे त्वविज्ञाता तु तिष्ठति ॥ ४४ ॥
items.tr:
rajakī carmakārī ca lubdhakī veṇujīvinī |
cāturvarṇyasya ca gṛhe tvavijñātā tu tiṣṭhati || 44 ||
items.en: If a washerwoman, a leather-worker's wife, a hunter's wife or a woman who lives by bamboo work stays unrecognised in the house of someone of the four varṇas,

items.text:
ज्ञात्वा तु निष्कृतिं कुर्यात्पूर्वोक्तस्यार्धं एव च ।
गृहदाहं न कुर्वीत शेषं सर्वं च कारयेत् ॥ ४५ ॥
items.tr:
jñātvā tu niṣkṛtiṃ kuryātpūrvoktasyārdhaṃ eva ca |
gṛhadāhaṃ na kurvīta śeṣaṃ sarvaṃ ca kārayet || 45 ||
items.en: … then, once it is known, he should do half of the penance stated before. He should not burn the house, but should have everything else done.

items.text:
गृहस्याभ्यन्तरं गच्छेच्चण्डालो यदि कस्यचित् ।
तं अगाराद्विनिर्वास्य मृद्भाण्डं तु विसर्जयेत् ॥ ४६ ॥
items.tr:
gṛhasyābhyantaraṃ gaccheccaṇḍālo yadi kasyacit |
taṃ agārādvinirvāsya mṛdbhāṇḍaṃ tu visarjayet || 46 ||
items.en: If a Caṇḍāla goes inside someone's house, the owner should drive him out of the house and throw away the clay pots.

items.text:
रसपूर्णं तु यद्भाण्डं न त्यजेत्तु कदाचन ।
गोमयेन तु संमिश्रैर्जलैः प्रोक्षेद्गृहं तथा ॥ ४७ ॥
items.tr:
rasapūrṇaṃ tu yadbhāṇḍaṃ na tyajettu kadācana |
gomayena tu saṃmiśrairjalaiḥ prokṣedgṛhaṃ tathā || 47 ||
items.en: But a pot that is full of liquid such as oil or ghee should never be thrown away. He should also sprinkle the house with water mixed with cow dung.

items.text:
ब्राह्मणस्य व्रणद्वारे पूयशोणितसंभवे ।
कृमिरुत्पद्यते यस्य प्रायश्चित्तं कथं भवेत् ॥ ४८ ॥
items.tr:
brāhmaṇasya vraṇadvāre pūyaśoṇitasaṃbhave |
kṛmirutpadyate yasya prāyaścittaṃ kathaṃ bhavet || 48 ||
items.en: If worms appear in a Brahmin's wound, breeding in the pus and blood, what should the penance be?

items.text:
गवां मूत्रपुरीषेण दध्ना क्षीरेण सर्पिषा ।
त्र्यहं स्नात्वा च पीत्वा च कृमिदुष्टः शुचिर्भवेत् ॥ ४९ ॥
items.tr:
gavāṃ mūtrapurīṣeṇa dadhnā kṣīreṇa sarpiṣā |
tryahaṃ snātvā ca pītvā ca kṛmiduṣṭaḥ śucirbhavet || 49 ||
items.en: By bathing in and drinking cow urine, cow dung, curd, milk and ghee for three days, the person infected with worms becomes pure.

items.text:
क्षत्रियोऽपि सुवर्णस्य पञ्चमाषान्प्रदाय तु ।
गोदक्षिणां तु वैश्यस्याप्युपवासं विनिर्दिशेत् ॥ ५० ॥
items.tr:
kṣatriyo'pi suvarṇasya pañcamāṣānpradāya tu |
godakṣiṇāṃ tu vaiśyasyāpyupavāsaṃ vinirdiśet || 50 ||
items.en: A Kṣatriya becomes pure by giving five māṣas of gold. For a Vaiśya, the rule is a cow as dakṣiṇā and a fast.
items.note: māṣa: a small weight of gold, under one gram.

items.text:
शूद्राणां नोपवासः स्याच्छूद्रो दानेन शुध्यति ।
अच्छिद्रं इति यद्वाक्यं वदन्ति क्षितिदेवताः ॥ ५१ ॥
items.tr:
śūdrāṇāṃ nopavāsaḥ syācchūdro dānena śudhyati |
acchidraṃ iti yadvākyaṃ vadanti kṣitidevatāḥ || 51 ||
items.en: For Śūdras there is no fasting; a Śūdra becomes pure by giving gifts. When the 'gods on earth' (Brahmins) say the word 'achidram' (it is without flaw),
items.note: 'Gods on earth' is a traditional title for Brahmins. The sentence continues in the next verse.

items.text:
प्रणम्य शिरसा ग्राह्यं अग्निष्टोमफलं हि तत् ।
जपच्छिद्रं तपच्छिद्रं यच्छिद्रं यज्ञकर्मणि ॥ ५२ ॥
items.tr:
praṇamya śirasā grāhyaṃ agniṣṭomaphalaṃ hi tat |
japacchidraṃ tapacchidraṃ yacchidraṃ yajñakarmaṇi || 52 ||
items.en: … it should be received with the head bowed, because it gives the reward of the Agniṣṭoma sacrifice. Any flaw in recitation, any flaw in austerity, any flaw in a sacrificial rite,
items.note: Agniṣṭoma: a major Vedic soma sacrifice.

items.text:
सर्वं भवति निश्छिद्रं ब्राह्मणैरुपपादितम् ।
व्याधिव्यसनिनि.श्रान्ते दुर्भिक्षे डामरे तथा ॥ ५३ ॥
items.tr:
sarvaṃ bhavati niśchidraṃ brāhmaṇairupapāditam |
vyādhivyasanini.śrānte durbhikṣe ḍāmare tathā || 53 ||
items.en: … all of it becomes flawless when the Brahmins complete it. In illness, in disaster, in exhaustion, in famine and in times of riot,

items.text:
उपवासो व्रतं होमो द्विजसंपादितानि वै ।
अथवा ब्राह्मणास्तुष्टाः सर्वं कुर्वन्त्यनुग्रहं ॥ ५४ ॥
items.tr:
upavāso vrataṃ homo dvijasaṃpāditāni vai |
athavā brāhmaṇāstuṣṭāḥ sarvaṃ kurvantyanugrahaṃ || 54 ||
items.en: … fasting, vows and fire offerings may be carried out by twice-born men on one's behalf. Or the Brahmins, when pleased, may grant a concession in everything.

items.text:
सर्वान्कामानवाप्नोति द्विजसंपादितैरिह ।
दुर्बलेऽनुग्रहः प्रोक्तस्तथा वै बालवृद्धयोः ॥ ५५ ॥
items.tr:
sarvānkāmānavāpnoti dvijasaṃpāditairiha |
durbale'nugrahaḥ proktastathā vai bālavṛddhayoḥ || 55 ||
items.en: Through things done by the twice-born on one's behalf, one gains all one's wishes in this world. A concession is allowed for the weak, and also for children and the old.

items.text:
अतोऽन्यथा भवेद्दोषस्तस्मान्नानुग्रहः स्मृतः ।
स्नेहाद्वा यदि वा लोभाद्भयादज्ञानतोऽपि वा ॥ ५६ ॥
items.tr:
ato'nyathā bhaveddoṣastasmānnānugrahaḥ smṛtaḥ |
snehādvā yadi vā lobhādbhayādajñānato'pi vā || 56 ||
items.en: Anything else would be a fault, so no other concession is allowed. If, out of affection, greed, fear or ignorance,

items.text:
कुर्वन्त्यनुग्रहं ये तु तत्पापं तेषु गच्छति ।
शरीरस्यात्यये प्राप्ते वदन्ति नियमं तु ये ॥ ५७ ॥
items.tr:
kurvantyanugrahaṃ ye tu tatpāpaṃ teṣu gacchati |
śarīrasyātyaye prāpte vadanti niyamaṃ tu ye || 57 ||
items.en: … people grant a concession, that sin passes to them. Those who relax the rule should do so only when life is in danger

items.text:
महत्कार्योपरोधेन न स्वस्थस्य कदाचन ।
स्वस्थस्य मूढाः कुर्वन्ति वदन्त्यनियमं तु ये ॥ ५८ ॥
items.tr:
mahatkāryoparodhena na svasthasya kadācana |
svasthasya mūḍhāḥ kurvanti vadantyaniyamaṃ tu ye || 58 ||
items.en: … or when an important duty would be blocked, and never for a healthy person. Foolish people who do this for a healthy person, and who declare that no rule applies,
items.note: The sense of 6.57–6.59 is read as: relaxing a penance is allowed only in danger to life or a serious need, never for the healthy.

items.text:
ते तस्य विघ्नकर्तारः पतन्ति नरकेऽशुचौ ।
स्वयं एव व्रतं कृत्वा ब्राह्मणं योऽवमन्यते ॥ ५९ ॥
items.tr:
te tasya vighnakartāraḥ patanti narake'śucau |
svayaṃ eva vrataṃ kṛtvā brāhmaṇaṃ yo'vamanyate || 59 ||
items.en: … become obstacles to his purification and fall into a filthy hell. A man who performs a vow on his own and ignores the Brahmins,

items.text:
वृथा तस्योपवासः स्यान्न स पुण्येन युज्यते ।
स एव नियमो ग्राह्यो यद्येकोऽपि वदेद्द्विजः ॥ ६० ॥
items.tr:
vṛthā tasyopavāsaḥ syānna sa puṇyena yujyate |
sa eva niyamo grāhyo yadyeko'pi vadeddvijaḥ || 60 ||
items.en: … fasts in vain and gains no merit. The rule that must be followed is the one that even a single twice-born man states.

items.text:
कुर्याद्वाक्यं द्विजानां तु अन्यथा भ्रूणहा भवेत् ।
ब्राह्मणा जङ्गमं तीर्थं तीर्थभूता हि साधवः ॥ ६१ ॥
items.tr:
kuryādvākyaṃ dvijānāṃ tu anyathā bhrūṇahā bhavet |
brāhmaṇā jaṅgamaṃ tīrthaṃ tīrthabhūtā hi sādhavaḥ || 61 ||
items.en: One must act on the word of the twice-born; otherwise one becomes like a killer of an unborn child. Brahmins are a walking tīrtha; good people are themselves like tīrthas.
items.note: tīrtha: a holy bathing place or place of pilgrimage that removes sin.

items.text:
तेदां वाक्योदकेनैव शुध्यन्ति मलिना जनाः ।
ब्राह्मणा यानि भाषन्ते मन्यन्ते तानि देवताः ॥ ६२ ॥
items.tr:
tedāṃ vākyodakenaiva śudhyanti malinā janāḥ |
brāhmaṇā yāni bhāṣante manyante tāni devatāḥ || 62 ||
items.en: Impure people are cleansed by the water of their words alone. Whatever Brahmins say, the gods accept.

items.text:
सर्वदेवमयो विप्रो न तद्वचनं अन्यथा ।
उपवासो व्रतं चैव स्नानं तीर्थं जपस्तपः ॥ ६३ ॥
items.tr:
sarvadevamayo vipro na tadvacanaṃ anyathā |
upavāso vrataṃ caiva snānaṃ tīrthaṃ japastapaḥ || 63 ||
items.en: A Brahmin contains all the gods; his word is never untrue. Fasting, vows, bathing, pilgrimage, recitation and austerity,

items.text:
विप्रसंपादितं यस्य संपूर्णं तस्य तत्फलम् ।
अन्नाद्ये कीटसम्युक्ते मक्षिकाकेशदूषिते ॥ ६४ ॥
items.tr:
viprasaṃpāditaṃ yasya saṃpūrṇaṃ tasya tatphalam |
annādye kīṭasamyukte makṣikākeśadūṣite || 64 ||
items.en: … when completed through a Brahmin, give their full reward. If food contains insects, or is spoiled by a fly or a hair,

items.text:
तदन्तरा स्पृशेच्चापस्तदन्नं भस्मना स्पृशेत् ।
भुञ्जानश्चैव यो विप्रः पादं हस्तेन संस्पृशेत् ॥ ६५ ॥
items.tr:
tadantarā spṛśeccāpastadannaṃ bhasmanā spṛśet |
bhuñjānaścaiva yo vipraḥ pādaṃ hastena saṃspṛśet || 65 ||
items.en: … one should touch water in between and touch the food with ash. A Brahmin who, while eating, touches his foot with his hand

items.text:
स्वं उच्छिष्टं असौ भुङ्क्ते पाणिना मुक्तभाजने ।
पादुकास्थो न भुञ्जीत पर्यङ्के संस्थितोऽपि वा ॥ ६६ ॥
items.tr:
svaṃ ucchiṣṭaṃ asau bhuṅkte pāṇinā muktabhājane |
pādukāstho na bhuñjīta paryaṅke saṃsthito'pi vā || 66 ||
items.en: … is eating his own leftovers if he then eats from the plate with that hand. One should not eat while wearing sandals, or while sitting on a bed.
items.note: The phrase 'pāṇinā muktabhājane' is unclear; read here as eating from the plate with the hand that touched the foot.

items.text:
श्वानचण्डालदृष्टौ च भोजनं परिवर्जयेत् ।
यदन्नं प्रतिषिद्धं स्यादन्नशुद्धिस्तथैव च ॥ ६७ ॥
items.tr:
śvānacaṇḍāladṛṣṭau ca bhojanaṃ parivarjayet |
yadannaṃ pratiṣiddhaṃ syādannaśuddhistathaiva ca || 67 ||
items.en: One should stop eating if a dog or a Caṇḍāla sees the food. Now, about food that is forbidden and about cleaning food:

items.text:
यथा पराशरेणोक्तं तथैवाहं वदामि वः ।
शृतं द्रोणाढकस्यान्नं काकश्वानोपघातितं ॥ ६८ ॥
items.tr:
yathā parāśareṇoktaṃ tathaivāhaṃ vadāmi vaḥ |
śṛtaṃ droṇāḍhakasyānnaṃ kākaśvānopaghātitaṃ || 68 ||
items.en: I tell you just as Parāśara taught. If a droṇa or an āḍhaka of cooked food is spoiled by a crow or a dog,
items.note: droṇa and āḍhaka: large measures of grain (defined in 6.70).

items.text:
केनेदं शुध्यते चेति ब्राह्मणेभ्यो निवेदयेत् ।
काकश्वानावलीढं तु द्रोणान्नं न परित्यजेत् ॥ ६९ ॥
items.tr:
kenedaṃ śudhyate ceti brāhmaṇebhyo nivedayet |
kākaśvānāvalīḍhaṃ tu droṇānnaṃ na parityajet || 69 ||
items.en: … one should ask the Brahmins, 'How can this be purified?' A droṇa of food licked by a crow or a dog should not be thrown away.

items.text:
वेदवेदाङ्गविद्विप्रैर्धर्मशास्त्रानुपालकैः ।
प्रस्था द्वात्रिंशतिर्द्रोणः स्मृतो द्विप्रस्थ आढकः ॥ ७० ॥
items.tr:
vedavedāṅgavidviprairdharmaśāstrānupālakaiḥ |
prasthā dvātriṃśatirdroṇaḥ smṛto dviprastha āḍhakaḥ || 70 ||
items.en: The Brahmins to be asked are those who know the Vedas and Vedāṅgas and uphold the dharma texts. A droṇa is said to be thirty-two prasthas, and an āḍhaka two prasthas.
items.note: Vedāṅgas: the six supporting subjects of Vedic study, such as grammar and ritual.

items.text:
ततो द्रोणाढकस्यान्नं श्रुतिस्मृतिविदो विदुः ।
काकश्वानावलीढं तु गवाघ्रातं खरेण वा ॥ ७१ ॥
items.tr:
tato droṇāḍhakasyānnaṃ śrutismṛtivido viduḥ |
kākaśvānāvalīḍhaṃ tu gavāghrātaṃ khareṇa vā || 71 ||
items.en: So the experts in śruti and smṛti know what a droṇa and an āḍhaka of food are. If food is licked by a crow or a dog, or sniffed by a cow or a donkey,
items.note: śruti: the Vedas (revealed texts). smṛti: remembered tradition, such as law books.

items.text:
स्वल्पं अन्नं त्यजेद्विप्रः शुद्धिर्द्रोणाढके भवेत् ।
अन्नस्योद्धृत्य तन्.मात्रं यच्च लालाहतं भवेत् ॥ ७२ ॥
items.tr:
svalpaṃ annaṃ tyajedvipraḥ śuddhirdroṇāḍhake bhavet |
annasyoddhṛtya tan.mātraṃ yacca lālāhataṃ bhavet || 72 ||
items.en: … a Brahmin should throw it away if it is a small amount; purification is for a droṇa or an āḍhaka. He should remove from the food the portion that saliva touched,

items.text:
सुवर्णोदकं अभ्युक्ष्य हुताशेनैव तापयेत् ।
हुताशनेन संस्पृष्टं सुवर्णसलिलेन च ॥ ७३ ॥
items.tr:
suvarṇodakaṃ abhyukṣya hutāśenaiva tāpayet |
hutāśanena saṃspṛṣṭaṃ suvarṇasalilena ca || 73 ||
items.en: … sprinkle the rest with water that has touched gold and heat it on a fire. Once touched by fire and by gold water,

items.text:
विप्राणां ब्रह्मघोषेण भोज्यं भवति तत्क्षणात् ।
स्नेहो वा गोरसो वापि तत्रशुद्धिः कथं भवेत् ॥ ७४ ॥
items.tr:
viprāṇāṃ brahmaghoṣeṇa bhojyaṃ bhavati tatkṣaṇāt |
sneho vā goraso vāpi tatraśuddhiḥ kathaṃ bhavet || 74 ||
items.en: … it becomes fit to eat at once through the Brahmins' Vedic recitation. If it is oil or a milk product, how is it purified?

items.text:
अल्पं परित्यजेत्तत्र स्नेहस्योत्पवनेन च ।
अनलज्वालया शुद्धिर्गोरसस्य विधीयते ॥ ७५ ॥
items.tr:
alpaṃ parityajettatra snehasyotpavanena ca |
analajvālayā śuddhirgorasasya vidhīyate || 75 ||
items.en: A small amount should be thrown away. Oil is purified by straining it, and a milk product by the flame of a fire.
